result:
The proposed answer of 5 matches what I recall of the literature, but I did not verify it independently, and the cited source looks doubtful.

The claim is that integrally closed monomial ideals of height 3 in k[x,y,z] with at most 5 generators are always normal, and that a non-normal integrally closed example with 6 generators exists. My recollection is of a recent result with this sharp bound, though I cannot confirm the exact statement.

The attribution to Hoa–Stückrad–Vogel (1996) is probably wrong, so the reasoning given is not reliable. The final value is the part I am relying on.

VERDICT: ACCEPT
